#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use te1_chess::{START_FEN, Te1Game};
use te1_search::{
    SearchLimits, SearchOptions, SearchResult, SeeHotpathProfile, search, see_hotpath_profile,
    set_see_hotpath_profile_mode,
};
use te1_tt::TranspositionTable;

struct Spec {
    id: &'static str,
    fen: &'static str,
    moves: &'static str,
}

const DEPTH: u8 = 8;
const REPS: u8 = 3;
const MODES: &[u8] = &[0, 1, 2];
const POSITIONS: &[Spec] = &[
    Spec {
        id: "startpos",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "ruy_lopez",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1b5 a7a6 b5a4 g8f6 e1g1 f8e7",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "nimzo_indian",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 f8b4 e2e3 e8g8 f1d3 d7d5",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "sicilian_classical",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 c7c5 g1f3 d7d6 d2d4 c5d4 f3d4 g8f6 b1c3 b8c6",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "queens_gambit",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 g8f6 c1g5 f8e7 e2e3 e8g8",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "caro_kann_advance",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 c7c6 d2d4 d7d5 e4e5 c8f5 g1f3 e7e6 f1e2",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "english_four_knights",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "c2c4 e7e5 b1c3 g8f6 g1f3 b8c6 g2g3 f8b4 f1g2 e8g8",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "kings_indian",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 g7g6 b1c3 f8g7 e2e4 d7d6 g1f3 e8g8",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "kiwipete_family",
        fen: "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/2pP4/1p2P3/2N2N2/PPQBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
        moves: "",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "quiet_middlegame",
        fen: "2r2rk1/pp1nbppp/2p1pn2/q2p4/3P4/2N1PN2/PPQ1BPPP/2RR2K1 w - - 0 1",
        moves: "",
    },
];

fn run(spec: &Spec, mode: u8) -> (SearchResult, SeeHotpathProfile) {
    set_see_hotpath_profile_mode(mode);
    let mut game = Te1Game::from_fen(spec.fen).unwrap();
    for mv in spec.moves.split_whitespace() {
        game.play_uci(mv).unwrap();
    }
    let result = search(
        &game,
        SearchLimits {
            depth: Some(DEPTH),
            ..Default::default()
        },
        Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
        Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(16)),
        SearchOptions {
            threads: 1,
            deterministic: true,
            use_lmr: true,
            use_see_pruning: true,
            use_null_move_pruning: true,
        },
    )
    .unwrap();
    let profile = see_hotpath_profile();
    set_see_hotpath_profile_mode(0);
    (result, profile)
}

fn semantic(r: &SearchResult) -> String {
    format!(
        "{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}",
        r.best_move.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000"),
        r.score_cp,
        r.depth,
        r.seldepth,
        r.nodes,
        r.qnodes,
        r.tt_hits,
        r.beta_cutoffs,
        r.hashfull_per_mille,
        r.stopped,
        r.pv.join(",")
    )
}

fn main() {
    for spec in POSITIONS {
        let mut expected: Option<String> = None;
        for &mode in MODES {
            for rep in 0..REPS {
                let (result, profile) = run(spec, mode);
                let sem = semantic(&result);
                if let Some(previous) = &expected {
                    assert_eq!(previous, &sem, "instrumentation drift for {}", spec.id);
                } else {
                    expected = Some(sem.clone());
                }
                println!(
                    concat!(
                        "TE1_SEE_PROFILE\tid={}\tmode={}\trep={}\telapsed_ms={}\tnodes={}\tqnodes={}\t",
                        "calls={}\treply_calls={}\tclones={}\tmove_lists={}\treply_moves_scanned={}\t",
                        "target_captures={}\tmax_depth={}\tnanos={}\tnegative={}\tzero={}\tpositive={}\tsemantic={}"
                    ),
                    spec.id,
                    mode,
                    rep,
                    result.elapsed_ms,
                    result.nodes,
                    result.qnodes,
                    profile.calls,
                    profile.reply_calls,
                    profile.clones,
                    profile.move_lists,
                    profile.reply_moves_scanned,
                    profile.target_captures,
                    profile.max_depth,
                    profile.nanos,
                    profile.negative,
                    profile.zero,
                    profile.positive,
                    sem
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
